1/4 lb fresh green beans, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2 cans (14-1/2 oz each) diced tomatoes with basil, oregano and garlic
In a Dutch oven, cook sausage and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain.
Stir in the carrots and celery; cook for 3 minutes.
Add the squash, green beans and garlic; cook 1 minute longer.
Stir in the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer until vegetables are tender and barley is cooked.
